steps.instruction: Marinate curry-cut chicken in curd, ginger-garlic and biryani masala for 2 hours.
Par-boil soaked basmati to 70% with whole spices; drain the moment it bends.
Layer chicken, rice, birista, mint and coriander. Two layers, never three.
Seal and dum on low flame 25 minutes; do not open to check.
Rest 10 minutes, open at the table.

recipes.platingNotes: Handi service. Rice grains separate, one leg piece visible per portion.

steps.instruction: Marinate mutton overnight with raw papaya, curd and masala.
Pressure-cook mutton to 80% before layering — it will not cook through on dum.
Par-boil rice to 70%, layer with birista, mint and saffron milk.
Dum 30 minutes on tawa over low flame.
Rest 12 minutes before opening.

recipes.platingNotes: Handi service, two pieces on the bone per portion.

steps.instruction: Cut vegetables to even 20 mm; blanch the hard ones only.
Sauté with biryani base masala until the raw smell goes.
Layer with 70% cooked rice, birista, mint.
Dum 20 minutes, rest 10.

recipes.platingNotes: Handi service, vegetables visible in the top layer.

steps.instruction: Cook tikka in the tandoor first; boiled chicken makes a flat curry.
Reduce makhani gravy on low, whisking, until it coats a spoon.
Mount with butter and cream off the flame — boiling the cream splits it.
Crush kasuri methi in and rest 2 minutes.

recipes.platingNotes: Cream swirl, butter cube, coriander sprig.

steps.instruction: Warm the makhani gravy; do not let it catch on the base.
Add paneer cubes for the last 3 minutes only.
Finish with butter, cream and crushed kasuri methi.

recipes.platingNotes: Cream swirl, julienned ginger.

steps.instruction: Soak whole urad overnight; short soaking is the usual cause of a grainy dal.
Pressure-cook 45 minutes until completely soft.
Simmer on low with tomato, butter and cream for at least 3 hours, stirring often.
Finish each order with butter and a cream swirl.

recipes.platingNotes: Served in a handi, butter cube on top.

steps.instruction: Marinate 25 g chicken cubes in curd, chilli and ginger-garlic for 1 hour.
Coat in corn flour, fry at 170 °C.
Temper curry leaves and chilli, toss the fried chicken through.

recipes.platingNotes: Dry, deep red, curry leaves on top.

steps.instruction: Check every fillet on arrival — firm flesh, clear eyes, no ammonia.
Build the tamarind-tomato base fully before the fish goes in.
Slide fillets in and simmer 6 minutes without stirring.
Rest 5 minutes; the curry tastes better settled.

recipes.platingNotes: Two fillets, gravy ladled over, curry leaf.

steps.instruction: Soak basmati 30 minutes.
Temper cumin in ghee until it crackles.
Cook rice 1:1.5 with water, covered, on low.
Rest 10 minutes, fluff with a fork.

recipes.platingNotes: Grains separate, cumin visible.

steps.instruction: Knead soft dough, prove 2 hours covered.
Portion 130 g balls.
Tandoor 90 seconds.
Butter immediately off the heat.

recipes.platingNotes: Folded once, butter side up.

steps.instruction: Knead wheat dough medium-stiff; rest 45 minutes.
Portion 90 g, roll to 6 inches.
Tandoor 60–75 seconds.

recipes.platingNotes: Plain, no butter unless ordered.

steps.instruction: Make the dough soft; a tight dough gives a hard centre.
Fry at 130 °C only — high heat browns the outside and leaves the middle raw.
Soak in warm syrup at least 2 hours before service.

recipes.platingNotes: Two pieces, warm syrup, pistachio.

steps.instruction: Hang the curd in muslin for 30 minutes until thick — watery marinade will not cling.
Whisk in ginger-garlic paste, chilli, garam masala, turmeric and salt.
Crush kasuri methi between the palms and fold in with oil and lemon juice.
Label with date and hold below 5 °C. Discard after 3 days.

recipes.platingNotes: Batch of 1 litre marinates roughly 20 portions.

steps.instruction: Slice onions to an even 2 mm — uneven slices burn before the rest colours.
Fry at 160 °C in batches until pale gold; they darken after draining.
steps.ccp: Oil at 160 °C — above 180 °C turns them bitter

steps.instruction: Drain on rack, cool fully, store airtight.

recipes.platingNotes: Yields about 1 kg birista from 2.8 kg raw onion.

steps.instruction: Pick leaves, wash in three changes of water, spin dry.
Grind with chilli, garlic, salt, sugar and lemon using ice water, not tap water.
Portion into 200 g tubs; make fresh daily.

recipes.platingNotes: Colour holds for a day; anything greying goes in the bin.

steps.instruction: Sweat chopped garlic and ginger in hot oil without colouring.
Add sauces, vinegar and sugar; simmer 6 minutes.
Slurry the corn flour in cold water and thicken to a coating consistency.
Cool rapidly to below 5 °C within 90 minutes.

recipes.platingNotes: One litre dresses about 11 portions.

steps.instruction: Cut paneer into 40 g cubes; anything smaller dries out on the skewer.
Marinate with tandoori marinade and hung curd for at least 45 minutes.
Skewer alternating with capsicum and onion petals.
Cook in tandoor 4–5 minutes, basting once with butter.
Finish with chaat masala and lemon off the heat.

recipes.platingNotes: Six cubes per skewer on a bed of onion rings, green chutney on the side.

steps.instruction: Trim and cube chicken to 35 g; pat completely dry.
First marination: ginger-garlic, lemon, salt — 20 minutes.
Second marination in tandoori marinade — minimum 2 hours, ideally overnight.
Tandoor 6–7 minutes, baste with butter, rest 2 minutes.
Dust with chaat masala, squeeze lemon, serve immediately.

recipes.platingNotes: Five pieces, sliced onion, lemon wedge, chutney ramekin.

steps.instruction: Grate cabbage and carrot, salt lightly, squeeze out all water.
Bind with corn flour and maida — no egg, no water.
Roll into 25 g balls and fry at 170 °C until deep gold.
Toss in manchurian base only at the pass so the balls stay crisp.

recipes.platingNotes: Eight balls, sauce napped not drowned, spring onion on top.

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into 25 g strips, marinate in soy, pepper and corn flour for 20 minutes.
Fry at 175 °C until just cooked; do not overload the basket.
Wok-toss peppers and onion on high flame for 90 seconds only.
Add sauces, return chicken, toss and serve — total wok time under 4 minutes.

recipes.platingNotes: Semi-dry, high gloss, spring onion greens scattered.

steps.instruction: Blanch florets 2 minutes in salted water, then shock in ice water.
Coat in curd, chilli, ginger-garlic and flours; rest 15 minutes.
Double-fry: 160 °C to cook, 185 °C to crisp.
Toss with curry leaves and chaat masala.

recipes.platingNotes: Piled high, lemon wedge, onion rings.

steps.instruction: Dry-roast coriander seeds and red chilli, crush coarse — kadai masala is never fine.
Sear onion and capsicum batons on high heat, keep them crunchy.
Add tomato, kadai masala, cook until oil separates.
Fold paneer in at the end; overcooking turns it rubbery.

recipes.platingNotes: Serve in a kadai, kasuri methi crushed over, ginger julienne.

steps.instruction: Roast the chettinad spices separately and grind with cashew — never use ready masala.
Brown onions properly; pale onions give a thin gravy.
Add chicken, sear, then the ground masala and tomato.
Simmer covered 18 minutes until the gravy clings.

recipes.platingNotes: Thick clinging gravy, pepper-forward, curry leaf garnish.

steps.instruction: Blanch spinach 90 seconds, shock in ice water — this is what keeps it green.
steps.ccp: Shock immediately or colour is lost

steps.instruction: Purée with green chilli, do not over-blend.
Temper cumin, onion, tomato; add purée last and cook under 5 minutes.
Fold paneer and finish with cream off the flame.

recipes.platingNotes: Bright green, not olive. Cream swirl, butter cube.

steps.instruction: De-vein and rinse prawns; check every piece.
steps.ccp: Reject any prawn with soft shell or ammonia smell

steps.instruction: Build the onion-tomato masala fully before the prawns go in.
Add prawns for the last 4 minutes only — longer and they toughen.
Rest 2 minutes off the heat before serving.

recipes.platingNotes: Six prawns visible on top, coriander, lemon.

steps.instruction: Knead a soft dough with milk and curd; rest covered 2 hours.
steps.ccp: Prove at room temperature, use within 6 hours

steps.instruction: Portion 130 g balls, press with chopped garlic and coriander.
Slap onto the tandoor wall; 90 seconds is the whole cook.
Brush with butter as it comes off.

recipes.platingNotes: Butter side up, folded once, served hot.

steps.instruction: Soak basmati 30 minutes, drain fully.
Temper whole spices in ghee until fragrant, not dark.
Add vegetables, rice and 1.5× water; cook covered on low.
steps.ccp: Do not stir after the water goes in

steps.instruction: Rest 10 minutes before fluffing with a fork.

recipes.platingNotes: Grains separate, birista and mint on top.

steps.instruction: Grate carrot fine; coarse grating never softens properly.
Cook in milk on low until completely dry — this is the whole dish.
steps.ccp: Reduce fully, no free milk left

steps.instruction: Add sugar (it loosens again), then ghee, then khoya.
Finish with cardamom and roasted cashew.

recipes.platingNotes: Warm, ghee glistening, cashew on top.

steps.instruction: Boil water with crushed ginger and cardamom for 2 minutes.
Add tea, boil 1 minute, then milk and sugar.
Bring to a rolling boil twice and strain.

recipes.platingNotes: Served in a glass, 180 ml fill.

steps.instruction: Juice the lemon to order; pre-juiced lime turns bitter within an hour.
Build over ice with sugar syrup and salt.
Top with chilled soda, do not stir more than twice.

recipes.platingNotes: Tall glass, lemon wheel, straw.
